'''Pad Thai''' is a noodle dish that heals {{Hp|10}} and grants {{EffectLink|Night Vision}} for 10 minutes.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/crafting/pad_thai.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
Dough, a [[Cooked Fish|cooked fish]] or [[Cooked Large Fish|cooked large fish]], sugar, a carrot, an egg and a [[bowl]]. Picking up a carrot unlocks the recipe.

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating Pad Thai takes 1.6 seconds, heals {{Hp|10}} and gives Night Vision for 10:00. The bowl is given back.

=== Trading ===
It is one of the foods a villager can ask for as its [[favorite food]].
